name: return_targets
notes: one row per (asset, cutoff_utc, horizon) for eligible designations whose session h has a Bhav Copy
available_utc is the close instant of session h and is always after cutoff_utc
cutoffs: 08:30 Asia/Kolkata on every MCX trading session per mcx_sessions from 2021-02-01 to 2026-10-23 (the last Bhav Copy); horizons [5, 10, 20] sessions, k = 1 is the cutoff's own session

designation: highest volume_lots summed over the two completed sessions before the cutoff among contracts listed on those sessions, excluding contracts whose staggered tender period has begun by the cutoff session and contracts whose expiry session is at or before session h; ties by earlier expiry then contract id; the winner must have traded (volume > 0)

expiry session: for compulsory-delivery products (gold, silver, copper) the last full open non-holiday session at or before the printed expiry (Bhav Copy rows of GOLD05OCT22FUT, COPPER31MAR25FUT and COPPER31MAR26FUT end there); for cash-settled crude the last trading session at or before it (three crude contracts expired on evening-only holiday sessions). The rule reproduces the last Bhav Copy row of all 199 finished contracts

tender period: the last N trading sessions including the expiry session, N per mcx_contract_specs.json (gold 5 through the June 2026 expiry then 3; silver 5 through July 2026 then 3; copper 5 through December 2024 then 3; crude none). Every non-closed mcx_sessions date counts as a trading session

roll plan: when the designated contract's last eligible session is before session h, the chain moves on the next session to the highest-volume contract (same two-session volumes) not in delivery on that transition session and not expiring within the horizon, the rolling contract excluded; applied recursively

sigma_c: sample standard deviation (ddof 1) of the 20 most recent daily log settlement returns of the historical chain before the cutoff, where session s uses the contract designated at cutoff s for the same horizon and log(settle_s / settle_(s-1)) on that contract; a session whose designation differs from the previous session's, or has none, is skipped and the window extends backwards

wealth chain: W_0 = 1 at P_ref; W_k^q = W_(k-1)^close * D_k^q / D_(k-1)^close for q in open, high, low, close (close = settlement); on a transition to B the denominator is B_(k-1)^close. A missing settlement stops the chain and makes labels from that session on ungradable
no synthetic rows: a session where the chain contract printed no trade keeps its settlement-based w_close and has null open/high/low
